== Summary ==
Slip “•You’ve Never Won A Race?” cut unchanged from page 1 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/DShieldUpdateKit_2024_July.pdf July 2024 Defensive Shield Update Kit] (PDF file created 2 August 2024), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (596, 585, 1109, 870)). Recorded with version [[You've Never Won A Race? (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2): cut from that card image, with the same words; a slip that reprints a card image is recorded with that version, not as a separate version. Not a recreation.

== Preservation ==
archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-0/00/VD-D-youveneverwonarace-2024-08-02-sheet-slip.png Internet Archive item].
